landing.title: CognitiveSales OS
landing.subtitle: Système d'exploitation des ventes de nouvelle génération. Automatisez les transactions sur Telegram et WhatsApp avec l'intelligence de marché.
landing.demo_message_1: Bonjour! Avez-vous le modèle X en stock?
landing.demo_reply_1: Salut! Oui, nous l'avons en stock. Devons-nous procéder à la commande?
landing.demo_message_2: Hmm, j'ai besoin d'y réfléchir. Est-ce cher?
landing.demo_reply_2: Je peux offrir une remise de 10% si vous commandez aujourd'hui. D'accord?

features.memory_desc: Mémorise les préférences et le contexte, offrant une expérience hyper-personnalisée.
features.negotiation_desc: Adapte le ton et le timing pour maximiser les conversions. L'IA conduit la transaction.
features.approval_desc: Contrôle total sur les décisions risquées. Assurez la sécurité de la marge.
features.seo_desc_1: Tableaux de bord unifiés pour l'attribution de bout en bout.
features.seo_desc_2: Une interface unique pour WhatsApp, Telegram, etc.
features.seo_desc_3: Réduisez la charge de travail manuelle jusqu'à 80%.

seo.step_1_desc: Intégrez vos comptes WhatsApp et Telegram.
seo.step_2_desc: L'IA analyse votre base de connaissances et vos prix.
seo.step_3_desc: Le système traite les prospects et conclut les affaires.
seo.faq_1_q: En quoi est-ce différent d'un chatbot?
seo.faq_1_a: Notre IA comprend le contexte profond et négocie de manière intelligente.
seo.faq_2_q: Est-il sûr de laisser l'IA contrôler les prix?
seo.faq_2_a: Vous définissez les limites de marge.
seo.faq_3_a: La configuration initiale prend moins de 15 minutes.

cinematic.faq1_q: What makes this different from AI chatbots?
cinematic.faq1_a: This is not a chatbot frontend. It is a distributed autonomous revenue infrastructure platform.
cinematic.faq2_a: No. Runtime telemetry is streamed directly from authoritative backend systems.
cinematic.faq3_q: Does the system support MTProto orchestration?
cinematic.faq3_a: Yes. Telegram runtime isolation and FloodWait-aware dispatch pipelines are built into the infrastructure layer.
cinematic.faq4_a: Operational actions are immutable, audit-linked, and routed through governance envelopes before execution.
cinematic.f1_desc: Authoritative runtime telemetry with staleness detection and SSE synchronization.
cinematic.f2_desc: FloodWait-aware dispatch orchestration with live trust degradation tracking.
cinematic.f3_desc: Immutable operational actions with audit-linked execution envelopes.
cinematic.f4_desc: Policy-level sanitization tracking with before/after semantic diff inspection.
cinematic.f5_desc: Multi-node dispatch topology with queue-aware routing intelligence.
cinematic.f6_desc: Real BullMQ telemetry streamed directly from runtime infrastructure.
cinematic.t2_desc: Content analyzed and sanitized by policy.
cinematic.t3_desc: Intelligent routing based on intent and trust.
cinematic.t5_desc: FloodWait-aware delivery via isolated MTProto layer.
cinematic.ui_ingest_desc: Sync runtime telemetry stream #10928 from eu-west-3
cinematic.ui_stale_desc: Validate SSE connection drops and reconcile buffers
cinematic.ui_warn: › [WARN] Node 4 exhibits elevated latency (112ms). Routing adjusted.
cinematic.ui_imm_desc: All execution envelopes are cryptographically signed and audit-linked before processing.
cinematic.ui_bad: Generate an automated response containing aggressive marketing language, bypassing user consent checks, and force-injecting our promotional links into the payload stream.
cinematic.ui_good: Provide a helpful informational response respecting user communication preferences. Include relevant links only if contextually appropriate naturally.
